2048 AI Player

  • I made an AI that plays 2048!!!
  • i'm obsessed with 2048! and i want to learn about machine learning! natural solution? combine the two!
  • problem: i'm a stupid little undergrad with a smooth little brain and do not know much about neural networks
  • thought process: i want to use imitation learning, since playing random moves in 2048 is a surefire way to end the game early, and frankly i didn't want to think of a way to "quantify" or "rank" how good a move is. with imitation learning, each state-action pair is directly labeled, which is pretty great and seemed doable
  • I did manage to find some datasets of 2048 games online, but after digging into the stats, it turns out those players don’t perform nearly as well as I do. I've been mildly (okay, extremely) obsessed with 2048 since I was around ten, and my highscore pictured below, speaks for itself. Simply put, I am very good at this game. The existing datasets don’t reflect that level of play, and frankly, they fall short compared to my own. If I want my model to do well, it should learn from the best (me). Therefore, I think the models will do well if it imitates my play style.
  • while reading online, the first "method" i came across was using multilayer perceptrons.
